source.title: Test of parametrized post-Newtonian gravity with galaxy-scale strong lensing systems
source.sample: 80 mass-selected observed lenses from SLACS, BELLS, LSD and SL2S

publishedConstraint.confidence: 68% statistical interval for fixed fiducial lens-structure parameters
publishedConstraint.systematicWarning: Authors report approximately 25% systematics from density slope, anisotropy and light profile.

closure.equation: Fierz-Pauli static dust: bar(h)00=4U/c^2, bar(h)ij=0; trace reversal gives h00=hij=2U/c^2 and gamma=1
requiredProof: massless spin-2 continuum spectrum from the SubQG graph action
continuum Lorentz invariance from the SubQG graph action
universal minimal coupling of massive and massless excitations

conclusion.reason: gamma=1 is empirically compatible but is still a conditional no-slip closure, not yet derived from the canonical SubQG microaction.
